rule_metadata.author: MahirAli Khan
rule_metadata.title: DNS Query to Wildcard DNS Services - Network

rules.rule_text:
title: DNS Query to Wildcard DNS Services - Network
id: 139ddcb3-ba90-4407-b0b1-1838131ce8e7
related:
- id: 4f8a1c2e-7d3b-4e5f-9a6c-0b1d2e3f4a5b
  type: similar
status: experimental
description: 'Detects DNS queries to public wildcard DNS services that dynamically
  resolve subdomains to IP addresses embedded in the subdomain.

  Adversaries abuse these services to establish C2 channels or stage phishing infrastructure
  without registering a custom domain, potentially to evade detection and attribution.

  '
references:
- https://nip.io/
- https://sslip.io/
- https://traefik.me/
- https://github.polettix.it/ETOOBUSY/2022/10/09/nip-io-sslip-io/
author: MahirAli Khan
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
- attack.command-and-control
- attack.t1071.004
- attack.t1568
logsource:
  category: dns
detection:
  selection:
    query|endswith:
    - .1u.ms
    - .backname.io
    - .nip.io
    - .sslip.io
    - .traefik.me
    - .xip.io
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Developers using nip.io or sslip.io to test local HTTPS setups or Kubernetes ingress
  rules without modifying /etc/hosts
- CI/CD pipelines that provision ephemeral review environments with dynamically generated
  hostnames (e.g. PR-based preview deployments)
level: medium
